threat_name: Direct Prompt Injection Against LLM Controls
attack_vector: An adversary submits a malicious prompt directly to the AI component to override instructions, disable guardrails, or coerce privileged behavior.

mitigations.description: Separate trusted instructions from user-controlled content
mitigations.implementation: Use structured prompt templates, explicit role separation, allow-listed tools, and server-side policy checks before executing model-driven actions.

threat_name: Indirect Prompt Injection Through Retrieved or Plugin Content
attack_vector: The AI component ingests malicious instructions from untrusted documents, websites, vector-store results, or plugin output and follows them as if they were trusted instructions.

mitigations.description: Treat retrieved content and plugin results as untrusted
mitigations.implementation: Sanitize retrieved context, isolate tool outputs, enforce content boundaries, and require policy validation before the model can act on external instructions.

attack_vector: An attacker induces the model to reveal system prompts, hidden instructions, safety policies, or protected chain-of-thought-like control material.

mitigations.description: Minimize exposure of hidden prompts and sensitive control logic
mitigations.implementation: Keep sensitive instructions server-side, redact protected prompt material from logs and responses, and test prompt leakage paths regularly.

threat_name: Model or Sensitive Context Exfiltration via Inference API
attack_vector: Attackers repeatedly query the inference interface to extract model behavior, protected prompts, tenant data, or sensitive retrieved content.

mitigations.description: Constrain model and retrieval output exposure
mitigations.implementation: Enforce tenant isolation, output filtering, per-user quotas, and strict authorization around retrieved context and model metadata.

attack_vector: Unvalidated training or fine-tuning data may allow an attacker to introduce hidden triggers or unsafe behavior. A stated validation gap does not establish that the dataset or model has actually been poisoned.

mitigations.description: Gate training data with provenance and validation controls
mitigations.implementation: Require signed sources, dataset review, anomaly detection, and reproducible training pipelines before accepting new data for tuning.

attack_vector: The attacker coaxes the model into bypassing safety policies or execution constraints, enabling harmful outputs or higher-privilege operations.

mitigations.implementation: Validate actions and sensitive outputs with deterministic policy checks instead of relying solely on the model to honor safety instructions.

threat_name: Denial of ML Service Through Token or Compute Exhaustion
attack_vector: Oversized prompts, repeated long-context requests, or tool-intensive chains consume model tokens, GPU resources, or downstream retrieval capacity until the service degrades or fails.

mitigations.description: Apply request budgets and model execution limits
mitigations.implementation: Enforce prompt size caps, per-tenant quotas, timeout controls, and bounded tool recursion for model-driven workflows.

threat_name: AI-Enabled Identity Spoofing and Deepfake Phishing
attack_vector: Adversaries use generated identities, voice/video deepfakes, or AI-enhanced phishing to defeat user verification flows and gain access to protected systems.

mitigations.implementation: Require phishing-resistant MFA, step-up verification for sensitive actions, and anti-automation controls for account recovery and onboarding.

threat_name: Prompt Self-Replication or Autonomous Agent Persistence
attack_vector: An attacker embeds instructions that persist across agent steps or tool invocations, allowing malicious behavior to survive beyond a single prompt and influence later actions.

mitigations.description: Reset and validate agent state between high-risk steps
mitigations.implementation: Constrain long-lived memory, clear untrusted context, require approval for stateful tool chains, and validate persisted instructions before reuse.
